purpose: Staged worldwide LinkedIn collection rollout (configuration only — does not enable targets or Beat).

waves.name: pilot_hold
waves.description: Keep existing pilot targets only; Beat and live LinkedIn OFF.

waves.name: tier_a_keywords
waves.description: Top 5 high-signal keywords across all 40 countries.

waves.name: full_manifest
waves.description: Full 2000 manifest pairs — only after sustained error rate and LinkedIn health checks.

readiness_criteria: VPS pytest linkedin suite green on deployed SHA
Pilot DB job count unchanged or monotonically grown (no destructive migration)
Redis queue depth stable (<5) between Beat ticks under load test
Failed-run rate <5% over 24h in active wave
No VERIFICATION_REQUIRED / AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED spikes in last 24h
Worker memory and CPU within VPS budget (documented in PHASE_3 doc)
rollback_steps: Set ALLOW_LIVE_LINKEDIN_COLLECTION=false and CELERY_ALLOW_LINKEDIN_TASKS=false on worker
Stop beat container or remove celery profile
Disable enabled LinkedIn collection_targets beyond pilot hold (operator CLI)
Purge stale Redis collection queue only if no tasks should complete (optional)
Preserve global_jobs_pilot and production global_jobs DBs — no drop
